# User Documentation

Welcome to **QuickText**! This guide covers everything you need to know to get the most out of your new scratchpad.

## Summoning QuickText
QuickText is designed to be "invisible" until you need it. You can summon or hide the scratchpad in two ways:
1.  **Global Hotkey**: Press the user-defined shortcut (default is often `Option + Space`) from any app, including full-screen ones.
2.  **Menu Bar Icon**: Click the pencil icon (`square.and.pencil`) in your macOS Menu Bar at the top of your screen.

## Note Taking
- **Automatic Save**: You never have to click "Save." QuickText records every character as you type it.
- **Persistence**: Your notes remain even if you quit the app or restart your Mac.
- **Zero Latency**: The editor is optimized for speed; it's ready the millisecond the window appears.

## Customization
Access settings by clicking the **Gear Icon** at the bottom of the scratchpad window and selecting **Settings...**.

### Settings Options
- **Shortcut**: Click to record a new global key combination.
- **Window**:
    - **Stay on top**: Keeps the scratchpad above all other windows.
    - **HUD Style**: Toggles between a standard window look and a high-contrast dark "Heads-Up Display" style.
- **Font**: Change the typeface and size of your notes.
- **Startup**: Enable **Start QuickText when I log in** to have your scratchpad ready as soon as you turn on your Mac.

## Tips
- **Quick Dismiss**: Click the red Close button or press your hotkey again to hide the window. The app stays running in the background.
- **Spaces**: QuickText follows you! It will appear on whichever "Space" or Desktop you are currently using.
